provenance: Original source profiles, attributed paraphrases and typed research questions assembled from public linked material. Publisher text and copyrighted reports are not republished.
license: MIT for code; CC BY 4.0 for original annotations and compilation; publisher rights retained for linked material.
scope: Middle East source directory and country-extensible political research. Syria remains the first curated evidence and ontology collection; regional publisher profiles do not establish country-level events.
country_extension_status: Syria is the only curated collection; other country workspaces begin empty.

catalogue_input.access_route: Committed data/sources/catalogue-review.json, docs/catalogue-methodology.md and public evidence URLs; historical private input identifiers are optional archival metadata only.
catalogue_input.verification_scope: Organizational evidence review, not article accuracy certification
catalogue_input.field_evidence_note: Relevant-source navigation index, not certified field-level corroboration.
catalogue_input.reproduction: Use committed data/sources/catalogue-review.json and public evidence URLs. Historical private file identifiers are optional archival metadata, not publicly accessible dependencies.

historical_research.scope: Separate attributed data layers; not reviewed political assertions or a live feed.
